topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon my partner's bucket list the other day, tucked away in a photo album. Each item written with such hopeful enthusiasm, from learning to play the guitar to visiting the northern lights. I've been quietly planning, eager to surprise them with a few of these dreams. The way they light up over new experiences—it's contagious, and I can't wait to be part of making these moments happen. Maybe this weekend, we'll start with a small adventure, just to set the tone. It's the little surprises that make life sparkle, after all.
